observed_failure: Across repeated live turns, the assistant could convert the user's latest framing into a causal conclusion, oscillate between local and upstream explanations, or explain the correction and stop despite existing hypothesis-first/root-scope policy and available authorized repair work.
governing_outcome: The acting Agent must independently derive an evidence-bounded causal model, preserve multiple contributing causes when warranted, select exactly one current intervention/no-change decision separately from causality, execute the admitted intervention when authorized, and bind verification/validation evidence to the methods planned before action.

supported_contributing_causes.evidence: Controlled finalization accepted a precomputed RootScopeReceipt and could not prove the receipt was derived from the raw signals/evidence/assessment for the current user correction.
Legacy require_root_scope_admission mechanically required exactly one SELECTED hypothesis, compressing multi-factor/systemic explanations into one root layer.

Several prior tests manually constructed receipts, FinalizationContext objects or scenario artifacts, proving component contracts existed but not that a real user-correction trajectory was evidence-to-action complete.

rejected_or_bounded_alternatives.evidence: A user correction is a valid trigger and hypothesis source but is not independent current-system causal evidence.

The reproduced gap is concentrated in cognition/finalization semantics; unrelated authority ownership, continuity, domain health and mutation topology retain independent production evidence. Replacing them would widen the failure surface without evidence of necessity.
Equivalent hypothesis-first, macro challenge and premature-repair guidance existed before recurrence, so additional prose alone does not close the execution path.

external_method_evidence: NASA systems engineering: preserve governing requirement/objective traceability through verification and validation rather than equating implementation completion with fitness for use.
SEI ATAM: architecture decisions are evaluated through business drivers, scenarios, risks and tradeoffs rather than familiarity or a single structural view.
Google SRE incident learning: repeated failures require systemic contributing-cause analysis and concrete corrective/preventive actions rather than repeated human reminders.
MIT CAST/STAMP: avoid root-cause seduction and oversimplification of causality for complex socio-technical/system failures.

architecture_candidates.reason: Preserves the reproduced live failure class.
Improves provenance but leaves singular-root causal compression and intervention/result mismatch open.
Insufficient evidence that unrelated controller subsystems require replacement.
Directly closes both reproduced contributors while preserving unrelated proven control-plane mechanisms.

review_findings_closed: Selected intervention and terminal repair/no-change disposition are mechanically bound by candidate ID and no-change semantics.
Verification/validation evidence carries method_ref and controlled finalization requires coverage of the exact predeclared methods.

Architecture/control interventions must supply raw ArchitectureExperienceCase data and pass require_architecture_experience_admission, including CURRENT_AGENT dogfood, concern-driven representations, competing candidates and FAILURE_AND_RECOVERY scenario.
The selected intervention requires substantive current-system evidence/tradeoff evidence; USER_CLAIM alone cannot select rebuild or another action.
assurance_boundary: The redesign is enforced in UAOS-controlled runtimes that invoke the finalization gate and in compatible Agents SDK output-guardrail paths. Native ChatGPT still has no verified repository-controlled pre-send hook, so this release does not claim physical complete mediation of every native-chat answer.
remaining_scope: Registered child domains remain on their owner-native current behavior assurance until each independently adopts and verifies Common Behavior 1.4; parent must not overstate child adoption.
Unknown future failure classes remain subject to normal post-promotion observation and recurrence detection.
Native ChatGPT pre-send mediation remains unverified.
